newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 309 bln lei t-bill issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Romania 309 bln lei t-bill issue oversubscribed.

text.p: An issue of 309.16 billion lei worth of three-month treasury bills was heavily oversubscribed on Wednesday, when 15 bidders entered a total 915.32 billion lei for the finance ministry's offer.
The T-bills bear an annual yield of 52 percent, a central bank statement showed. The previous yield was lower at 45 percent.

The bids ranged from 35 to 80 percent. Some 246.21 billion lei went to commercial banks operating in Romania, including branches and subsidiaries of foreign banks, and 62.95 billion lei went to their corporate clients.
